title: The Calendar: Days, Weeks and Months
seo_title: Calendar – Primary 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Name the days of the week and the months of the year; read a calendar; find dates and the number of days. (summary of the NERDC Primary 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 3 maths worksheets on the calendar: days of the week, months of the year, days in each month, reading dates and counting days and weeks. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: 30 days have September, April, June and November.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • There are 7 days in a week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
  • There are 12 months in a year, from January to December.
  • April, June, September and November have 30 days. February has 28 days (29 in a leap year). The others have 31.

Examples

Example

Today is Tuesday. What day is it in 3 days?

Wednesday, Thursday, Friday

Answer: Friday

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting today as one of the daysStart counting from tomorrow.
Thinking every month has 30 daysSome have 31 and February has 28 or 29.
Mixing up the order of monthsSay them in order: January, February, March, …

faq.q: Which month is Independence Day in Nigeria?
How many days in a year?

items.q: How many days are there in a week?
items.e: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday. That is 7 days. (5 is only the school days.)

items.q: Which day comes just after Tuesday?
items.e: Say the days in order: … Tuesday, Wednesday … So Wednesday comes just after Tuesday.

items.q: Which day comes just after Monday?
items.e: Say the days in order: … Monday, Tuesday … So Tuesday comes just after Monday.

items.q: Which day comes just after Sunday?
items.e: Sunday is the last day of the week. Then a new week starts with Monday.

items.q: Which day comes just before Friday?
items.e: Say the days in order: Wednesday, Thursday, Friday. Thursday comes just before Friday. (Saturday comes after Friday.)

items.q: Which day is missing?
items.e: Tuesday comes before the gap and Thursday comes after it. The missing day is Wednesday.

items.q: Which two days are the weekend?
items.e: Most children go to school from Monday to Friday. Saturday and Sunday are the weekend.

items.q: Which day comes just before the weekend?
items.e: The weekend starts on Saturday. The day just before Saturday is Friday.

items.q: The day after today is called …
items.e: Yesterday was the day before today. Tomorrow is the day after today.

items.q: The day before today is called …
items.e: Yesterday is the day before today. Tomorrow is the day after today.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day was yesterday?
items.e: Yesterday is the day before today. The day before Monday is Sunday. (Tuesday is tomorrow.)

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day will it be tomorrow?
items.e: Tomorrow is the day after today. The day after Thursday is Friday. (Wednesday was yesterday.)

items.q: Yesterday was Friday. What day is it today?
items.e: Today is the day after yesterday. The day after Friday is Saturday.

items.q: Tomorrow will be Wednesday. What day is it today?
items.e: Today is the day before tomorrow. The day before Wednesday is Tuesday.

items.q: How many months are there in a year?
items.e: January to December. Count them: there are 12 months in a year. (7 is the days in a week.)

items.q: Which is the first month of the year?
items.e: The year starts with January. December is the last month.

items.q: Which month comes just after March?
items.e: Say the months in order: February, March, April, May. April comes just after March.

items.q: Which month comes just before June?
items.e: Say the months in order: April, May, June, July. May comes just before June.

items.q: Which month comes just after December?
items.e: December is the last month. Then a new year starts with January.

items.q: Which month is missing?
items.e: September comes before the gap and November comes after it. The missing month is October.

items.q: How many months are there in 4 years?
items.e: 1 year = 12 months: 4 × 12 = 48 months.

items.q: How many months are there in 6 years?
items.e: 1 year = 12 months: 6 × 12 = 72 months.

items.q: How many days are there in August (not a leap year)?
items.e: Thirty days have September, April, June and November; February has 28 (29 in a leap year); the rest have 31: 31.

items.q: How many days are there in October (not a leap year)?
items.e: Thirty days have September, April, June and November; February has 28 (29 in a leap year); the rest have 31: 31.

items.q: How many months are there in 5 years?
items.e: 1 year = 12 months: 5 × 12 = 60 months.

items.q: How many days are there in February (not a leap year)?
items.e: Thirty days have September, April, June and November; February has 28 (29 in a leap year); the rest have 31: 28.

items.q: How many days are there in June (not a leap year)?
items.e: Thirty days have September, April, June and November; February has 28 (29 in a leap year); the rest have 31: 30.

items.q: How many days are there in 11 weeks?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days: 11 × 7 = 77 days.

items.q: How many months are there in 7 years?
items.e: 1 year = 12 months: 7 × 12 = 84 months.

items.q: How many months are there in 9 years?
items.e: 1 year = 12 months: 9 × 12 = 108 months.

items.q: How many days are there in 10 weeks?
items.e: 1 week = 7 days: 10 × 7 = 70 days.

items.q: How many months are there in 3 years?
items.e: 1 year = 12 months: 3 × 12 = 36 months.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day of the week will it be in 4 days?
items.e: 4 days = 0 weeks and 4 days. Count on 4 days from Monday: Friday.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be in 5 days?
items.e: 5 days = 0 weeks and 5 days. Count on 5 days from Wednesday: Monday.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be in 26 days?
items.e: 26 days = 3 weeks and 5 days. Count on 5 days from Wednesday: Monday.

items.q: Today is Saturday. What day of the week will it be in 19 days?
items.e: 19 days = 2 weeks and 5 days. Count on 5 days from Saturday: Thursday.

items.q: Today is Tuesday. What day of the week will it be in 29 days?
items.e: 29 days = 4 weeks and 1 day. Count on 1 day from Tuesday: Wednesday.

items.q: Today is Friday. What day of the week will it be in 25 days?
items.e: 25 days = 3 weeks and 4 days. Count on 4 days from Friday: Tuesday.

items.q: Today is Friday. What day of the week will it be in 30 days?
items.e: 30 days = 4 weeks and 2 days. Count on 2 days from Friday: Sunday.

items.e: 11 days = 1 week and 4 days. Count on 4 days from Thursday: Monday.

items.q: Today is Saturday. What day of the week will it be in 22 days?
items.e: 22 days = 3 weeks and 1 day. Count on 1 day from Saturday: Sunday.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day of the week will it be in 25 days?

items.e: 10 days = 1 week and 3 days. Count on 3 days from Sunday: Wednesday.

items.q: Today is Saturday. What day of the week will it be in 17 days?
items.e: 17 days = 2 weeks and 3 days. Count on 3 days from Saturday: Tuesday.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day of the week will it be in 4 days?
items.e: 4 days = 0 weeks and 4 days. Count on 4 days from Thursday: Monday.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day of the week will it be in 8 days?
items.e: 8 days = 1 week and 1 day. Count on 1 day from Monday: Tuesday.

items.q: Today is Sunday. What day of the week will it be in 19 days?
items.e: 19 days = 2 weeks and 5 days. Count on 5 days from Sunday: Friday.

items.q: Today is Friday. What day of the week will it be in 6 days?
items.e: 6 days = 0 weeks and 6 days. Count on 6 days from Friday: Thursday.

items.q: Today is Tuesday. What day of the week will it be in 20 days?
items.e: 20 days = 2 weeks and 6 days. Count on 6 days from Tuesday: Monday.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be in 3 days?
items.e: 3 days = 0 weeks and 3 days. Count on 3 days from Wednesday: Saturday.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be in 28 days?
items.e: 28 days = 4 weeks and 0 days. Count on 0 days from Wednesday: Wednesday.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day of the week will it be in 24 days?
items.e: 24 days = 3 weeks and 3 days. Count on 3 days from Monday: Thursday.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day of the week will it be in 5 days?
items.e: 5 days = 0 weeks and 5 days. Count on 5 days from Monday: Saturday.

items.q: Today is Sunday. What day of the week will it be in 4 days?
items.e: 4 days = 0 weeks and 4 days. Count on 4 days from Sunday: Thursday.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be in 18 days?
items.e: 18 days = 2 weeks and 4 days. Count on 4 days from Wednesday: Sunday.

items.q: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be in 15 days?
items.e: 15 days = 2 weeks and 1 day. Count on 1 day from Wednesday: Thursday.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day of the week will it be in 17 days?
items.e: 17 days = 2 weeks and 3 days. Count on 3 days from Thursday: Sunday.

items.q: Today is Tuesday. What day of the week will it be in 3 days?
items.e: 3 days = 0 weeks and 3 days. Count on 3 days from Tuesday: Friday.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day of the week will it be in 22 days?
items.e: 22 days = 3 weeks and 1 day. Count on 1 day from Thursday: Friday.

items.q: A holiday starts on 20 February and ends on 19 March. How many days is that, counting both the first and the last day?
items.e: February has 28 days: 28 − 20 = 8 days left in February, plus 19 days in March, plus the first day: 28 days.

items.q: A holiday starts on 6 May and ends on 8 June. How many days is that, counting both the first and the last day?
items.e: May has 31 days: 31 − 6 = 25 days left in May, plus 8 days in June, plus the first day: 34 days.

items.q: Babatunde eats breakfast. When is that?
items.e: Breakfast is the first meal of the day. We eat it in the morning.

items.q: The sun comes up. What part of the day is it?
items.e: The sun comes up at the start of the day. That is the morning.

items.q: Which happens in the morning?
items.e: We get up in the morning. Tea and bedtime are in the evening. Home time is in the afternoon.

items.q: School finishes for the day. What part of the day is it?
items.e: School finishes after lunch, before tea. That is the afternoon.

items.q: Temi goes to bed. When is that?
items.e: Children go to bed at the end of the day, in the evening.

items.q: Which happens in the evening?
items.e: Tea is the meal at the end of the day. We have it in the evening.

items.q: Which part of the school day comes first?
items.e: The day goes in this order: morning, lunchtime, afternoon, evening.

items.q: Which part of the day comes straight after the afternoon?
items.e: Morning, afternoon, then evening. The evening comes straight after the afternoon.

items.q: Put these in order: evening, morning, afternoon. Which is in the middle?
items.e: The order is morning, afternoon, evening. The afternoon is in the middle.

items.q: What happens first?
items.e: Follow the arrows from the left. The first box is wake up.

items.q: We make a cake. What happens last?
items.e: Follow the arrows to the end. The last box is eat it. (Mix it is first, not last.)

items.q: What happens next, after “water it”?
items.e: Find “water it”. Follow the arrow to the next box: it grows. (Plant a seed comes before, not after.)

items.q: What goes in the box with the ?
items.e: It comes after a bath and before sleep, so it is in the evening: read a story. Waking up, breakfast and school are in the morning.

items.q: What goes in the box with the ?
items.e: It comes after the morning and before the afternoon. That is lunchtime.

items.q: Yetunde gets up. Next she has breakfast. Then she goes to school. What does she do last?
items.e: First she gets up. Next she has breakfast. Last, she goes to school.

items.q: Ruth eats lunch. After lunch, she plays outside. What does she do first?
items.e: “After lunch, she plays” means lunch comes first. So she eats lunch first.

items.q: You dry your hands ____ you wash them.
items.e: First you wash your hands. Then you dry them. So you dry them after you wash them.

items.q: Tea is in the evening. Breakfast is in the morning. Which do you have first in the day?
c: they are at the same time
items.e: The morning comes before the evening. So breakfast comes first.

items.q: Hauwa eats breakfast. When is that?
items.e: Breakfast is the first meal of the day. We eat it in the morning.

items.q: Chidi goes to bed. When is that?
items.e: Children go to bed at the end of the day, in the evening.
